message:
Sam, Theo and Priya, four rigid wheels with grousers meaning traction bars float and grip without tracks. Black Point 1 (BP-1) meaning lunar basalt simulant shows high friction near 39 to 51 degrees with negligible cohesion in friction source E1 and bulk density near 1.6 to 1.9 grams per cubic centimetre in density source E2, and the 300 millimetre wheels give about 9.82 kilopascal ground pressure in ground-pressure calc evidence E10, like a person standing on soft snow, so sinkage stays shallow while grousers bite and track mass, height and power are saved for the lift and pack.

Sam, Theo and Priya, the front transverse drum meaning rotating bucket-wheel cutter digs with low steady reaction. Drum torque tests averaging near 39 newton cutting force in cutting source E4 and cutting source E5, described as counter-rotating drums in excavator source E6, leave about 39 newton against about 589 newton weight at the 60 kilogram limit for a 0.066 pull ratio in pull-ratio calc evidence E12, like lifting a 4 kilogram bag, so shallow 30 millimetre cuts hold traction if the hopper load stays centred for tip margin.

Sam, Theo and Priya, cut depth couples mobility to power and dump stability because deeper cut raises drive current and forward tip load. I am not ready while blocking objection O2 on mast lift and tip with stowed fit stays open, and I condition support for integration on closure of mass-energy and dump proofs owned by others.
